admissible_claim: The registered optimization problem is well posed for the admitted sample
inadmissible_claim: Observed acreage is generated by this objective alone
additional_requirement: Official aligned units constraints and complete scenario construction

admissible_claim: Ordinal suitability alone does not identify cardinal acreage
inadmissible_claim: A score rank causally determines acreage
additional_requirement: Document score scale ties uncertainty and geography-year alignment

admissible_claim: Recorded bounds are sufficient to force reversal in the stated feasible set
inadmissible_claim: Observed reversal proves farmer risk aversion
additional_requirement: Authoritative policy agronomic and capacity provenance

admissible_claim: A calibrated model may classify its fitted risk constraint as slack
inadmissible_claim: The real farmer risk constraint is slack
additional_requirement: External or identified kappa and optimal-set sensitivity

empirical_construct: Shadow prices and CVaR tail weights
admissible_claim: Primal-dual diagnostics validate the numerical program
inadmissible_claim: Solver duals are observed economic preferences
additional_requirement: Complete registered constraints and stable active-set audit

admissible_claim: A registered model admits a risk-feasible mean-improving local displacement
inadmissible_claim: Farmers would actually execute that displacement

admissible_claim: A named fitted family satisfies the tested ordering over a declared domain
inadmissible_claim: A larger empirical tail coefficient generally causes reversal
additional_requirement: Family validation fixed marginals and simultaneous uncertainty bands

admissible_claim: A frozen model exhibits zero one multiple or interval crossings
inadmissible_claim: The crossing is a universal structural threshold
additional_requirement: Preregistered grid refinement selection rule and optimal-face audit

admissible_claim: A crop pair meets predeclared diagnostic thresholds
inadmissible_claim: The flag implies optimal exclusion higher CVaR or causal harm
additional_requirement: Estimator uncertainty threshold sensitivity and explicit benchmark

admissible_claim: Recorded signals and feasible actions can support a model-based value calculation
inadmissible_claim: Information and flexibility are strictly complementary in practice
additional_requirement: Decision timing signal vintage counterfactual action sets and identification strategy
